Terrible Pho and a BUG deep in my smoothie!
Feb 2020
I decided to have a simple banana smoothie but a third of the way through I fished out a bug - luckily intact! I took the bug, and the remaining smoothie back to the counter with my receipt and was immediately given a refund. I didn't fancy anything else after that. 
In the meantime, my partner was eating a chicken Pho which was the worst he'd ever had! The 'chicken' was so terrible and hard he said he wouldn't have given it to our dog. 
All in all, a dreadful experience. Avoid and go to Noodle, Noodle over the road!

It took us awhile to figure out the system
May 2019 • Couples
When you enter in you are given a plastic card similar to a credit card. Walk around the many counters and when you order present your card which will be swiped and a receipt given to you. You can then go to many vendors and try different items and not deal with cash. When you leave you return your card to the cashier's counter and pay the total that had been swiped on your card. Easy, but we had no idea what to do with the card when it was first presented to us. BTW. we saw no beer, asked, and was led to the front of the establishment where it was sold. After you order you will be given a number to place on your table and the food will be brought to you. The food that we got was very good and very resonably priced. The downstairs was fairly dark with just artificial lighting but there are a few tables upstairs on a balcony with better daylight shining through. I really enjoyed this place and would return again for a lunch.

Very good and happy with it all...
May 2019 • Couples
I came across this place by chance, and I’m glad I did, I eaten here throughout my time on Ho Chi Minh city. They have several different cuisines and very traditional authentic food if you choose the right items on the menu. 
They have very good service, the waiters translate to English for you if needed. One thing I noticed that was lacking, they need more vegan/ vegetarian food to keep up with the food trend. 
I’m very pleased with this eatery and I recommend it for people who want quick, clean hygienic food. 
They have plenty of table spaces upstairs and downstairs. I will definitely go there again if I go back to Ho Chi Minh CIty. Thanks

Best Pho I tried in Ho Chi Minh City
Nov 2018 • Solo
Visited CoCoChin Food Court for the first time today & was appalled at the wide variety of Vietnamese food to choose from. There is still store selling Pho right at the front - known as “Pho Hai since 1982” & I ordered K2-02, their Special Beef Noodle Soup. And I tell you, of the many Pho I tried, this is the best. I understand from the chef that their broth is cooked almost 24 hours which explains the shiokness to the max. Do visit & try if you are in the area & never leave Vietnam unless you have try a bowl of Pho
